profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ General Motors | Infotainment
profile.summary:
I am an engineering and program execution professional with a background in software validation, SAFe and agile transformation, PMO and portfolio execution, and viewing systems engineering. I currently work at General Motors. My career has included roles as a Software Validation SME, SAFe Program Consultant, PMO Specialist/Agile Coach, and Senior Software Engineer, Viewing PIT Lead.

Today, I work at the intersection of viewing systems performance, calibration readiness, software releases, and issue resolution. I support camera-based features such as rear view, surround view, trailering, field of view, image quality, stitching, and guidelines. I also work closely with safety and quality teams to assess systemic issues, coordinate read-across, document root causes, and make sure corrective actions are supported by evidence.

A consistent part of my work has been making complex information easier for people to understand and use. I create dashboards, improve reporting, clarify ownership and traceability, and build practical tools that reduce manual work. I have also developed Glean-based automation to help teams find existing engineering documentation faster and use it to accelerate safety and quality work.

I care about building products that are safe, intuitive, and useful to the people who rely on them. I am passionate about continuous improvement, technical problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and helping teams move forward with clear information and accountability. I am self-motivated, detail-oriented, and willing to speak up when something needs attention. I enjoy learning how systems work, sharing what I learn, coaching others, and turning difficult problems into practical next steps.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Viewing Software PIT (Performance Integration Team) Lead
positions.description:
• Led the tracking and calibration of viewing software performance deliverables, ensuring optimal functionality.  
• Drive quality process improvements in the viewing software space, enhancing overall user experience.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to read and process Safety Tethers *S PRTS, contributing to safety compliance.

positions.title: Senior Program Manager - Vehicle Software Delivery
positions.description:
- Led transition of back-office app delivery from on-prem to scalable cloud infrastructure.
- Built and executed strategic program plans aligning engineering, product, and operations.
- Maintained ECS timing charts used by 20,000+ personnel to synchronize software/service releases.
- Utilized Jira/Jira Align to track milestones, risks, and roadmap execution in real-time.
- Enforced agile governance and cross-functional communication to ensure on-time delivery.
- Served as Jira Project Administrator for 10+ cross-functional project teams, configuring custom boards,   workflows, and dashboards to support agile execution and executive reporting.

positions.title: PMO Specialist - SDV Portfolio Management Office
positions.description:
- Managed initiative-level execution in Jira Align including capacity planning and forecasting.
- Delivered weekly roadmap audits and dashboard reporting for senior leadership.
- Supported alignment of governance process across teams for continuous improvement

positions.title: Agile Coach - Global Validation
positions.description:
- Delivered SAFe training to 1,000+ participants; scaled agile practices across the org.
- Supported VDDV (CAE) “Drive to Virtual by 2025” initiative via ART leadership and coaching.
- Facilitated agile ceremonies, PI planning, and delivery metrics for Validation, VDDV, and Software Development teams.

positions.title: Component Software Validation SME
positions.description:
- Managed CG2999 deliverables for ECUs (CSM,VCU, IPC, FIDM, CGM, HDLM, RVC) using GVDP timing.
- Delivered software release risk assessments and validation plans.
- Led Redesign of CG3000 post VTC late software change request documentation and tracked Red risk issues in PRTS.
-Drove LGE Info3.5 Low Radio to zero mandatory MISRA C/C++ violations, ensuring adherence to automotive safety and coding standards.

positions.title: Software Validation Engineer
positions.description:
-Led subsystem testing for infotainment features including Bluetooth, SiriusXM, AM/FM/Tuner, USB Media, Navigation, Speech Recognition, CarPlay, Android Auto, and Alert Manager.
-Created and maintained a comprehensive library of test cases based on requirement analysis and tracked coverage using Git.
-Utilized Optolyzer and NeoVi (Vehicle Spy) tools to analyze signals and identify defects during bench and vehicle testing; automated test scenarios using MX-Suite.
-Delivered detailed quality and specification reports to senior management to inform design decisions and improve validation coverage.
-Designed and enhanced test procedures, achieving 100% coverage of client specifications and on-time completion of all assigned validation activities.
positions.insights: Skills: Vehicle spy · Software Validation · Vehicle Spy · Client Requirements · Communication · Interpersonal Skills · Software Verification · CAN bus · In vehicle Infotainment · Software Quality · Team Management · Relationship Building · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

positions.title: Lead Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
-Led end-to-end validation of infotainment systems (BMW, Mercedes, Audi, VW, GM), including test planning, execution, and coordination of vehicle drives across Michigan, Chicago, NYC, and Canada.
-Performed bench and in-vehicle testing for SiriusXM, Bluetooth, Navigation, Speech Recognition, Traffic, AM/FM/Tuner, and media playback (iTunes/USB/MP3), ensuring quality across QNX and Windows Auto platforms.
-Developed test specification templates and authored test cases linked to customer requirements; validated software fixes and ensured defect traceability.
-Utilized tools and protocols including CAN, Ethernet, SQL, Telnet, BluePirat, and Jira for diagnostics, issue reporting, and analysis of system logs.
-Ensured compliance with Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) and prioritized issues based on customer impact and program requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Execution · XML · Software Configuration Management · Client Requirements · Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) · Communication · Python (Programming Language) · Interpersonal Skills · Management · In vehicle Infotainment · CANoe · SQL · Software Quality · Team Leadership · Project Plans · Team Management · Relationship Building · CAN · Leadership · Software Testing · Ethernet · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
-Performed validation testing on Ford Works, Blue&Me, and PACCAR infotainment systems, including features such as SiriusXM, Bluetooth, USB, AM/FM/Tuner, and voice recognition, using Windows CE platforms.
-Conducted daily road tests and executed test plans to ensure system reliability, feature functionality, and quality assurance.
-Analyzed system log files to identify root causes of defects and supported engineering teams with diagnostic insights.
-Logged detailed test results and defect reports using DOORS and internal bug tracking tools.
Prioritized and revalidated software issues based on customer requirements and criticality.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Interpersonal Skills · In vehicle Infotainment · Software Quality · Relationship Building · Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) · Perl · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving

positions.title: Marketing
positions.description:
Develop Company Website from concept of layout to completion   overseeing planning and troubleshooting.
Collect data on components such as sensors, drives, encoders, etc.
Attended numerous product line training sessions including: Weg, Control Techniques, Brady, Cutler Hammer, Edwards, etc.
Prepared ISO documents

positions.title: Sales
positions.description:
Counseled high volume of clients in identifying, filling and servicing their need for electronic products.
Resolved customer questions and concerns with relevant knowledge of product and services.
Took initiative and continually worked to find best solutions.
